newsitem.title: USA: Jury selection in Fla. tobacco suit still slow.
newsitem.headline: Jury selection in Fla. tobacco suit still slow.

text.p: Five members were added to the pool of potential jurors for a landmark anti-tobacco case Wednesday, bringing the pool's size to 62 out of the roughly 100 expected to be included.

Wednesday was the tenth day of jury selection for the suit, Norma Broin vs Philip Morris Cos Inc, which was filed on behalf of non-smoking flight attendants seeking as much as $5 billion in damages from tobacco firms for illnesses they attribute to breathing second-hand smoke on U.S.-based passenger jets. It is both the first class-action suit and first second- hand smoke case to make it to trial.
Jury selection is not expected to conclude before the middle of next week.
